title: Mud Pig
lines: Sam and the pig sit in the sun.
The pig runs to the mud.
The pig sits in the mud.
Sam gets a rag and a tub.
Sam rubs the pig in the tub.
The pig is wet. Sam is wet!
The pig naps in the sun.

questions.listenFor: Looking for cause and effect: Sam washed the pig, so Sam got wet too. If they just say "the tub," ask "and what happened in the tub?"

questions.ask: What did Sam use to get the pig clean?
questions.listenFor: A rag and a tub. This one is stated right in the story - if they can't find it, have them reread that line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Do you think the pig liked the tub? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. You are listening for a reason tied to the story - "no, because it ran to the mud" or "yes, because it naps at the end."
